title: Strategy被MSCI剔除风险或已提前计价，净mNAV跌破1可能成为投资机会

title: DEX 协议 Spirala 遭预言机操纵攻击损失约 1200 万美元，SPRL 一小时跌超 80%
excerpt: Odaily星球日报讯 据 PeckShield 监测，DEX 协议 Spirala 遭到攻击，攻击者通过闪电贷拉高低流动性池的现货价格，操纵其借贷模块使用的 TWAP 预言机，借出约 1200 万美元资产。SPRL 代币一小时内下跌超过 80%。项目方已暂停借贷模块。

title: Spirala loses $12 million in oracle manipulation exploit, pauses lending module
excerpt: The attacker used a flash loan to move the spot price of a thin liquidity pool that fed Spirala's short-window TWAP oracle, then borrowed against inflated collateral. The team said a post-mortem will follow.
